status: clarified primary endpoint before new data collection/training, preparation only; confirm exact family sampling and immutable holdout manifest before execution
source: 2026-11-20 提言確定版 p.14: calibration, within-decision risk ranking, conditional loss, family-out evaluation, suppress unreliable estimates
decisions: Numeric thresholds below are engineering preregistration proposals not literal reviewer thresholds; freeze before outer holdout acquisition/evaluation; no change after viewing results.

split.unit: campaign x seed lineage x complete match; all players, candidates, labels and calibration rows from one match stay together
split.development: existing 120 training and 30 development matches are development only
split.outer: new opponent-family and progression-policy holdouts; distinct campaigns and seeds; separate S42-adapter, bundled basic, and not-trained-in policy family (fixed efficiency-policy holdout allowed if not used for training or calibration)
split.leak: audit all available historical train/development/pilot/formal seed manifests and wall/trajectory hashes; lack of a manifest is a recorded limitation/blocker for strict independence; independent label replay and hidden-input perturbation tests
split.calibration: nested grouped cross-fit; tune calibrators only via training-side folds, refit on development side and freeze before outer evaluation

targets.legal_ron: per opponent and candidate red-aware exact legal Ron possibility before chosen action; not probability of choosing to Ron
targets.conditional_loss: counterfactual base Ron payment plus honba if legally accepted; exact settlement rules, ura uncertainty stated, not actual payment unless all relevant outcome/priority rules included
targets.expected_loss: legal-opportunity exposure points E[1(legal Ron)*counterfactual payment]; do not equate sum across opponents with any-Ron probability or actual total payout. Need separately evaluated all-accept settlement label accounting for multiple Ron and abortive draws for aggregate.
targets.not_q: no physical outcome probability/score from S42 raw Q

baselines: frozen 120-match T/R predictions, unchanged deterministic certain cases
candidate-side simple empirical frequency baseline trained on training fold only
conditional payment conditional median and mean baselines (mean for expected point loss), training-only

core_gate.validity: all input/label/seed audits pass; probabilities finite and bounded; confirmed legal furiten/riichi deterministic cases respected; P(legal Ron per opponent/candidate)<=P(tenpai same opponent) after consistent calibration; nonnegative point predictions; no hidden/future feature
core_gate.sample_support: per family and displayed stratum >=30 independent half-games, >=100 positive and >=100 negative for binary calibration; payment conditional >=100 positive labels across >=30 matches; mixed-response decision ranking >=100 choice sets with both classes across >=30 matches; otherwise suppress numbers, report insufficiency, no full gate pass
core_gate.calibration: Primary endpoint: candidate minus frozen legal-Ron log loss, excluding deterministic cases; promotion requires upper 95% paired match-bootstrap CI <0 pooled with pre-fixed equal family weighting. Brier candidate-minus-frozen point estimate <=0. For every supported family, both scores must have point estimate <=0; independently report CI (lower bound >0 implies supported deterioration). Tenpai calibration evaluated separately with same proper-score and reliability support rules. Max absolute calibration gap <=0.05 for supported fixed decile bins (>=200 rows, >=30 matches); unsupported bins not certified. Require supported strata for any numbers displayed; do not treat absence of statistical significance as noninferiority.
core_gate.risk_ranking: per-opponent, per-decision pairwise positive-negative AUC with ties half; candidate point estimate >= frozen and no supported deterioration per holdout family, report pooled and macro family AUC, no rank credit on all-negative or all-positive groups
core_gate.loss: conditional payment MAE must beat or tie training-only conditional median; conditional payment RMSE must beat or tie training-only mean; unconditional per-opponent exposure RMSE <= training-only frequency x mean baseline; 95% match-paired CIs on all; count and uncertainty by family; no unconditional exposure claim for unsupported strata
core_gate.release: P1 output used solely as explanation/comparison, never overrides Mortal; suppress inadequate calibration and legally uncertain labels; P1 development metrics are not final product approval

statistics.resample: paired match blocks within each family, 20000 draws, seed 261120; no candidate-level IID inference
statistics.report: Brier/log_loss/AUPRC, fixed-bin reliability with support, mixed-candidate ranking, conditional MAE/RMSE, exposure RMSE; ECE descriptive only
statistics.multiple: single primary calibration endpoint predeclared as candidate-minus-frozen legal-Ron log loss; Brier safety co-criterion, remaining metrics secondary/gates; claims of improvement confined to supported endpoint and family; no unplanned tuning on outer test

remaining: Need counterfactual score label generator independent audit and documented ura rules, full evaluator/CI/selection and data collection; first unit-tested metric primitives here.
